The error "[Unable to create KIO worker. Unknown protocol 'obsidian'](https://www.google.com/search?q=Unable+to+create+KIO+worker.+Unknown+protocol+%27obsidian%27&uact=5&mstk=AUtExfDHOZ_qN6ah4rpZFYA2-1e56yMOkdXbqKR09X5r0ZIpNMRid1PCLd71uXfI6zpv1Ht0SFvyeLFVrI6xYwSv8FITsOnQrHhbwe0Pzn3VHoDbdhaGUoxmuS3D0brON9w53ZU&csui=3&ved=2ahUKEwijw4P6t4OUAxXsTqQEHQQ5BDkQgK4QegQIARAB)" on Fedora (KDE Plasma) indicates that KDE's file manager (Dolphin) does not know how to handle `obsidian://` links because the Obsidian application has not registered itself as the handler for this protocol. ![GitHub](data:image/png;base64,)GitHub +2

This commonly happens when using the Obsidian AppImage or Flatpak, as they do not automatically integrate into the system's URL handler protocol. ![Obsidian Forum](data:image/png;base64,)Obsidian Forum +1

Primary Fix: Update or Create the `.desktop` File

You need to tell Linux that Obsidian handles `obsidian://` URIs by adding `%u` (or `%U`) to your desktop entry. 

1. **Locate your Desktop File:** Usually found at `~/.local/share/applications/obsidian.desktop`. 
2. **Edit the File:** Open it with a text editor.
3. **Update the Exec line:**
    - _Before:_ `Exec=/path/to/obsidian.AppImage`
    - _After:_ `Exec=/path/to/obsidian.AppImage %u`
    - _Note:_ The `%u` (lowercase) allows passing a single URI to the application. ![Obsidian Forum](data:image/png;base64,)Obsidian Forum +2
4. **Save** and run: `update-desktop-database ~/.local/share/applications/`
